name: CPU-based Gaussian Splatting Thumbnailer with JIT Optimization
definition: A lightweight method for efficient thumbnail generation from Gaussian Splatting data, leveraging Just-in-Time (JIT) compilation in Python to optimize performance-critical operations on CPU-based systems.
summary: This CPU-only thumbnailer generates rapid 3D Gaussian Splatting previews by approximating Gaussians as spheres and using Python's Numba JIT compiler for near-real-time performance without a GPU.
